title: Do not show the Wi-Fi connection as fully working before confirming if the connection is limited
line: Right after connecting, the network icon now spins and the "connection activated" notification waits until Plasma knows whether the Internet is reachable, for at most 30 seconds.
explanation: NetworkManager reports a connection as activated before its first connectivity check finishes (that check can take up to 20 seconds, e.g. while the router is still booting), and keeps the old 'none'/'unknown' connectivity until then. plasma-nm only looked at the activation state, so the tray icon showed a fully working connection and kded sent 'Connection activated', and only later switched to the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity'. A new shared ConnectivityCheck class in plasma-nm's library now tracks the check: it starts when a connection becomes activated while the check is enabled and the result is still unknown, and ends when the result arrives, the connection goes away, or after 30 seconds. The tray icon shows its busy indicator while the check runs, and kded holds the 'activated' notification until it ends: shown for full connectivity or at the 30 s limit, dropped for limited connectivity or a captive portal (those have their own notifications).

commits.message:
applet, kded: don't show a connection as working before it's checked

After activation, the icon and notification showed a connection as fine
while NetworkManager still checked whether it can reach the Internet.
Show it as busy and hold the notification until then, for up to 30 s.

BUG: 513222

media.caption: Connecting to HomeNet while the Internet is unreachable: 'activated' notification and a full Wi-Fi icon, then the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity' about 25 s later
Same sequence: the icon spins while the check runs, no 'activated' notification, then the limited icon and 'Limited Connectivity'
While the connectivity check is running, the icon already looks fully working
While the check is running, the icon shows the busy indicator
Internet reachable, check result after 8 s: 'Connection activated' and the full icon appear immediately
Same: the icon spins for 8 s, then the spinner stops and 'Connection activated' appears together with the result
Check result never arrives in time (50 s): full icon and 'Connection activated' right away
Same: the icon spins for 30 s, then the spinner stops and 'Connection activated' appears at the same moment; the limited icon follows when the result arrives

review.text: Introducing a shared ConnectivityCheck helper in plasmanm_internal with a 30-second cap used by both ConnectionIcon and kded Notification is a clean architectural direction. However, ConnectivityCheck treats every ActiveConnection equally without filtering out loopback, virtual, or non-default-route connections: on real NetworkManager systems where `lo` (or bridges/containers/VMs) is always Activated, disconnecting Wi-Fi during the check will NOT stop the 30-second spinner, and local-only/no-default-route connections (where NM stays at NoConnectivity) will spin and hold notifications for a full 30 seconds. The dbusmock test masked this by only simulating a single Wi-Fi connection.
changes: Filter out loopback, virtual/unsupported, and non-default-route connections in ConnectivityCheck (similar to UiUtils::isConnectionTypeSupported() in ConnectionIcon and the virtual/loopback exclusions in Notification::onCheckActiveConnectionOnResume()), or only track connections that actually have a default route (`default4()` / `default6()`) so `lo`, bridges, and local-only links neither trigger a 30 s spinner nor prevent the spinner from stopping on Wi-Fi disconnect.
Avoid relying implicitly on member-initialization/signal-connection order between Notification and ConnectivityCheck (and use `Qt::UniqueConnection` in `ConnectivityCheck::addActiveConnection()`).

Re-test with a realistic NetworkManager setup (including an active `lo` loopback connection and a local-only/no-gateway connection) to verify disconnect stops the spinner immediately and non-internet local connections do not stall for 30 s.

reviews.text: The direction matches the bug and Nate's confirmation: reuse Plasmoid.busy and hold the 'activated' notification until NM's first connectivity result, bounded at 30 s, from one shared ConnectivityCheck used by the icon and kded, with no new strings; the videos show all three timings. But ConnectivityCheck treats NoConnectivity as 'still checking' and starts on any active connection reaching Activated, with no filter on type or default route, unlike ConnectionIcon::setStates (isConnectionTypeSupported, VPN handling). NM reports NONE as a final result for connections with no default route, so starting a Wi-Fi hotspot while offline, a gateway-less/link-local wired link, or an NM-managed bridge/tun activating while offline will now spin the tray icon for the full 30 s and delay its 'activated' notification, which the fake-NM tests (always one Wi-Fi with a gateway) never exercised.
changes: Only start/keep the check for an activated, non-VPN connection of a supported type that carries the default route (ActiveConnection::default4()/default6()), so hotspots, link-local links and virtual interfaces don't spin or delay their notification.
Add a regression check for a hotspot or gateway-less connection while offline (connectivity NONE as final result): no spinner and an immediate 'activated' notification.
